title: Acting
overview: Five years ago, the Global Synchronic Urban Disappearance claimed the lives of Seria's family. A ticket to a new, hologram-enhanced style of theater opens Seria's eyes to a new world of possibilities, if she can muster the courage to take the next step.

title: A Theater Named Desire
overview: Seria returns to Alice in Theater to pursue her acting dreams. However, the girls of Alice In encounter an unexpected problem. They'll have to find a way to raise more money if they want to make it in the theater business.

title: Waiting for Airi
overview: Airi is haunted by her past. In order to continue in Alice in Theater, she must find a way to reconcile her feelings.

title: Birthday Party
overview: After a successful closing night, Alice in Theater begins preparing for its next production. As Seria polishes her acting skills, the anniversary of the Global Synchronic Disappearance arrives.

title: The Cherry Orchard
overview: After celebrating Seria's birthday, preparations continue for Alice in Deadly School. A surprise development throws a wrench in the troupe's plans. Can they find a solution to the problem so close to opening night?

title: The Creation of the World and Other Business
